title: Habit Body Text 1a
description: In this aspect of his work, Thomas is focusing his investigations on the way our joints move, their ranges of motion, and the programmed coordinations between different joints. He and his dancers work to become aware of habits from daily life or training and to devise tasks to retrain or restrain those habits and expand the palette of possibilities.
